title: Fundamental Rights vs Directive Principles: What's the Difference?
seoTitle: Difference Between Fundamental Rights and DPSP
seoDescription: Fundamental Rights (Part III) can be enforced in court; Directive Principles (Part IV) can't, under Article 37. Tables, key cases and laws DPSPs led to.
excerpt: A side-by-side table of Parts III and IV, the Directive Principles that became real laws from panchayats to the RTE Act, and the four Supreme Court cases that settled how the two fit together.
